notes: Posted 6 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted: the Watch Your Step Objective, Tatooine, Cantina and Docking Bay 94; starting interrupt Podrace Prep with Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer and Podrace Arena; 'Starting Effect' Seeking An Audience. I Did It! is listed right after Seeking An Audience under the same heading. All count toward the total.
Section headers mis-parsed by the draft ('Staring Interrupt', 'Starting Effect', 'Ships and vehicles', 'Droids', 'Used Interrupts', 'Lost Interrupts') are removed.

Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Light Premiere Tatooine system; 'Cantina' dested the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'Boonta Eve Pod Race' dested the Light Boonta Eve Podrace; 'Pod Race Arena' dested the Light Tatooine: Podrace Arena.

Posted 'Han w/pistol' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Dash' dested Dash Rendar; 'Artoo' dested the Jabba's Palace Artoo; 'Threepio with his jiggly parts showing' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing.
Posted 'Bantha Pimp droid' (in the Droids section) matches no card name; kept as written.
Total is 60 as published (no section counts are given).

The strategy updates say Jabba's Palace, Intruder Missile, X-wing Cannon, Power Pivot, Direct Assault and Fallen Portal went in for Artoo, A Gift, JP Audience Chamber, Luke's Lightsaber, one Mess and Effective Repairs; the list is kept as published (the original list).
The post says the deck is undefeated so far; no event is named, so it stays a general deck.
